name: parts-d
title: Shared parts · light
note: Every email is built from these. One brand look (Light and Electric), never the reader’s theme.

name: parts-dark-d
title: Shared parts · dark
note: The same pieces under prefers-color-scheme: dark.

name: invite-m
title: Invite · phone
note: The code on the share sheet’s ticket. The button carries the code (?code=), so the invite screen opens filled in.

name: invite-dark-m
title: Invite · phone, dark
note: What Apple Mail, iOS Mail and the Outlook apps show in dark mode.

name: invite-d
title: Invite · desktop
note: Desktop keeps the button its own width; phone runs it full width.

name: invite-320
title: Invite · 320
note: The 14-character code still fits on one line at 24px.

name: invite-noexpiry-m
title: Invite · no expiry
note: expires_at is null: the stub reads No expiry.

name: invite-named-m
title: Invite · a named code
note: A plain code (4 to 20 letters and numbers, no BETA-). Needs the invite-code.ts fix from custom-auth.

name: digest-m
title: Weekly digest · 3 shows · phone
note: Artist photos lead, with the Browse image treatment: 2px genre ring and the genre left edge.

name: digest-dark-m
title: Weekly digest · 3 shows · phone, dark
note: What Apple Mail, iOS Mail and the Outlook apps show in dark mode.

name: digest-d
title: Weekly digest · 3 shows · desktop
note: One column at every width, so nothing reflows between clients.

name: digest-more-d
title: Weekly digest · 5 shown, +4 more
note: Five rows at most, then +N more this week into Browse.

name: digest-one-m
title: Weekly digest · 1 show
note: Singular subject and title.

name: digest-zero-m
title: Weekly digest · a quiet week
note: Nobody they follow is in town: the zero note plus two taste picks. With no picks either, nothing is sent (live).

name: digest-zero-dark-m
title: Weekly digest · a quiet week, dark

name: digest-long-320
title: Weekly digest · long names at 320
note: Artist and tour wrap; venue drops under the date on phones.

name: digest-images-off-d
title: Weekly digest · images off
note: Outlook and privacy modes block images: alt text on the genre fallback, the logo’s alt stands in.

name: digest-outlook-d
title: Weekly digest · Outlook for Windows
note: No rounded corners or gradients: square cards, solid cyan edge and button. Still reads as us.

name: digest-zero-text
title: Weekly digest · quiet week, plain text

name: si-m
title: Sign-in code · phone
note: From “Email me a code instead”. Never names the account or anything in it.

name: si-dark-m
title: Sign-in code · phone, dark
note: What Apple Mail, iOS Mail and the Outlook apps show in dark mode.

name: si-d
title: Sign-in code · desktop
note: Same shape as the auth pages’ panel: the trail leads into the code.

name: si-nofrom-m
title: Sign-in code · no device line
note: When Clerk sends no requested_from, the line is left out, not left blank.

name: su-m
title: Verify email code · phone
note: Step 3 of 3 during the beta. A sign-up with a taken email gets no email at all (custom-auth rule 2).

name: su-dark-m
title: Verify email code · phone, dark
note: What Apple Mail, iOS Mail and the Outlook apps show in dark mode.

name: su-d
title: Verify email code · desktop
note: Same shape as the auth pages’ panel: the trail leads into the code.

name: pr-m
title: Password reset code · phone
note: Only sent when the address has an account; the page reads the same either way.

name: pr-dark-m
title: Password reset code · phone, dark
note: What Apple Mail, iOS Mail and the Outlook apps show in dark mode.

name: pr-d
title: Password reset code · desktop
note: Same shape as the auth pages’ panel: the trail leads into the code.

name: nd-m
title: New-device code · phone
note: After a right password on a new device. The amber card is for the person it wasn’t.

name: nd-dark-m
title: New-device code · phone, dark
note: What Apple Mail, iOS Mail and the Outlook apps show in dark mode.

name: nd-d
title: New-device code · desktop
note: Same shape as the auth pages’ panel: the trail leads into the code.

name: inbox-m
title: Inbox · subjects and preheaders
note: What shows before anyone opens one. No code in any subject or preheader.

name: unsub-off-m
title: Unsubscribe · digest off
note: The one-click link from the footer. No sign-in, same page whether or not the account exists.

name: unsub-off-dark-m
title: Unsubscribe · digest off, dark
note: Follows the device, like the emails.

name: unsub-bad-m
title: Unsubscribe · link didn’t work
note: Bad or tampered token, or a malformed link.

name: unsub-down-m
title: Unsubscribe · something went wrong
note: EMAIL_UNSUBSCRIBE_SECRET missing or the write failed.
